_comment: Asset registry. Final art from PixelLab lives in assets/sprites/pixellab/ (built by tools/pixellab_import.gd); placeholders stay in placeholder/ folders. Every texture/sound the game loads is referenced here by key. To use final art: put the new file next to the placeholder and change the path. Character/monster sets are folders with one sheet per animation: <anim>.png, rows = 8 directions (E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE), columns = frames. An optional "normal" folder with the same layout adds normal maps.

status_icons._comment: Status effect icons (HUD buff bar), by status id.

ui._comment: UI art. The font is a 16 px pixel font (use sizes 16/32/48 for crisp glyphs); the ornate frame is a 9-slice drawn over glass windows (margin = slice size in px).
